_comment: Expected column-B label for each individual row referenced inside an expression/list row spec in isp_technopara_map.json (e.g. COB-old's dry_coal_charge_oven='17/8' references rows 17 and 8 separately). isp_technopara_row_labels.json only covers simple int/numeric-string specs — a whole expression can't be checked against one label. Verified per real report files: a sheet can have more than one row-shift zone (e.g. Mar'24's COKE OVENS sheet shifted its 'Dry Coal Charge'/oven-count block by -4 rows but its coke-quality block by -7), so the per-unit blanket offset in _compute_unit_offset is not reliable for these specific rows — each is checked independently instead, exactly like _verified_row does for simple specs. Missing entries just fall back to the unit's blanket offset (or unchanged), never break extraction.
